tha-ap244:1.1: Nāgakesariya.] Dhanuṃ adejjhaṃ katvāna vanam ajjhogahiṃ ahaṃ / kesaraṃ osaraṃ disvā sabbamaṭṭaṃ supupphitaṃ. // //
tha-ap244:2.1: Ubho hatthehi paggayha sire katvāna añjaliṃ / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Tissassa lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap244:3.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ pupphaṃ abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap244:4.1: Sattasattat' ime kappe Pamokkharaṇa-nāmako / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap244:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Nāgakesariyo thero i. g. a-ti.
